in_arabic.name: تبسم

in_urdu.name: تبسم

The name is reminiscent of the sweet fragrance of jasmine and other exotic flowers, evoking a sense of beauty, tranquility, and grace. It reminds us of the importance of spreading goodness and positivity in the world, just as a pleasant smell uplifts and uplifts the spirits of those around it. The name also highlights the essence of God's presence in all things, as reflected in the Hadith, "Verily, God is beautiful and loves beauty," where the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) teaches us to seek and appreciate beauty in all its forms as a manifestation of God's divine creation. Essentially, the name "Tabassum" serves as a reminder to strive towards inner and outer beauty, and to spread its sweet fragrance in our daily lives.
